desc: Ideation: T-forced placement + F-window breaking strategy
Implement forced placement: array of size n+m-1, write str2 at each T index, detect conflicts → return ""
Detect impossible F windows (fully forced to equal str2) → return ""
Fill free positions with 'a', then for each unsatisfied F window flip rightmost free position to smallest char != str2 at that offset

Verify greedy correctness: rightmost-flip choice is lexicographically optimal; check interaction of overlapping F windows (one flip satisfying multiple windows); consider whether processing order of F windows matters
Test against examples: "TFTF"/"ab" → "ababa", "TFTF"/"abc" → "", "F"/"d" → "a", plus edge cases (all-T, all-F, str2 all 'a's, overlapping F windows sharing free positions)
